answer: The ledge schedule is applied in dune and haven exposes each instalment. A hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and hence 47% arrives at settlement and the rest over 16 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3611 identities would post 2325 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
